prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
| Return 3m            | +0.2% |
| Return 1m            | +1.3% |
| Return 1w            | +1.2% |
| Range position (63d) | 22% |
| 21d realized vol     | 23% |
| Last close           | 307.13 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows modest near-term momentum with returns in the last week and month, suggesting some upside potential but lacking strong conviction. The 22% range position implies room to move higher within its range, yet the+0.2% 3-month return and muted price action keep the visibility balanced. Overall, a cautious stance with expected drift sideways-to-up over ~20 trading days.

DECISION: HOLD
